newsitem.title: UK: UK Channel 4's Grade to head First Leisure.
newsitem.headline: UK Channel 4's Grade to head First Leisure.

text.p: Michael Grade, who announced on Monday that he was resigning as chief executive of Britain's Channel 4 television station, is to become executive chairman of First Leisure Plc, the company said on Wednesday.
Grade, who is already non-executive chairman of the leisure company, will assume his new role by July 31. First Leisure chief executive John Conlan will leave the company by the end of this year.
UK Channel 4's Grade to head First =2

First Leisure operates night clubs, bingo halls, bowling alleys and fitness centres across Britain -- plus tourist landmark the Blackpool Tower -- and is in the midst of a heavy investment programme. It plans to spend 55 million pounds ($89 million) on new facilities this year.
Grade joined the board of First Leisure in 1991 and has been non-executive chairman since March 1995. Conlan has been chief executive since 1988.
"John and I will be working closely together to ensure the smoothest possible transition," Grade said in a statement.

"The Board has fully endorsed the medium- and long-term investment strategy which John is implementing. I shall ensure First Leisure continues on its present and highly successful course," he added. ($1=.6175 Pound)
